title: A reserved appointment message
hook: Two stated cases: explore the reach and conversion of a stated reminder funnel.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the reach and conversion of a stated reminder funnel affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Purchases, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the reach and conversion of a stated reminder funnel in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Of 1000 toy visitors, fraction 0.8 stop and fraction 0.4 of those buy. How many purchases are expected?
